messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release v2026.3.1 canary rollout started in us-west-2 (canary group 2/10). Watchers: eng-runtime, eng-sre.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: spike in 5xx and memory OOMs from inference runtime on canary nodes in us-west-2. Alerting on-call.
Emma L: paging — I'm on call. joining the thread and switching to incident channel. any immediate mitigation suggestions?
Sanjay Patel: quick skim of logs shows repeated GC+OOMs tied to KV cache growth during model init. stacktrace points to new prefetch code in commit abcdef1.
Lia Chen: yup that's the change I landed earlier for per-request KV prefetch. It accidentally disables soft-cap on some shard placements, so cache keeps growing under certain traffic shapes. putting up a flag now.
Marco G: can we kill the feature flag first to avoid a rollback? I can flip it. command: 
```
curl -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/toggle" -d '{"flag":"enable_kv_prefetch","value":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
Marco G: flipping flag... :gear:
Marco G: flag flip succeeded, responses from canaries show immediate drop in memory allocs in metrics stream.
Sanjay Patel: nice — but some canaries already OOM'd and restarted a couple times, causing transient 5xx for affected customers. We should still plan for a single-commit revert and a tiny hotfix patch, then roll the hotfix to remaining canaries.
Lia Chen: agreed. I'll open a revert PR for abcdef1 -> revert-abcdef1 and cut v2026.3.1-hotfix. patch is just the revert + a guard on the prefetch default. ETA ~15-20m.
Emma L: customer impact calc: about 6 hosts in canary group (2/10) affected; estimated ~0.8% of global traffic, but concentrated on 3 Dedicated customers routed to those hosts — they saw 502/503 for ~4-6 minutes depending on retry windows. need CS notify.
Alex R: I can draft customer comms. suggested blurb: "We briefly observed elevated errors for inference requests after a canary deployment. We immediately disabled the feature and are rolling a hotfix; no data was lost. We'll follow up with root cause and remediation timeline." Want me to send now or wait for hotfix confirmation?
Emma L: send once hotfix is rolled into canary and metrics are stable. include apology and ETA for full prod rollout (TBD after canary).
Pedro M: I'm coming on shift in 12 minutes — Emma, can you hand off runbook pointer and current state?
Emma L: handoff notes:
- root cause: per-request KV prefetch change (commit abcdef1) removed soft-cap on cache for certain shard combos.
- immediate mitigation: `enable_kv_prefetch=false` feature flag (Marco flipped).
- next action: revert commit -> cut hotfix release v2026.3.1-hotfix -> deploy to remaining canaries then prod after verification.
- commands and observability:
  * check mem allocs: `./infra/metrics query 'sum(rate(mem_alloc_bytes[1m])) by (host)'`
  * flip flag: see curl above
  * revert PR: https://git.internal/repo/pull/revert-abcdef1 (Lia opening)
- customer note: Alex to send after canary bake confirmed
- logs: /var/log/inference/runtime/*.log filtered: `grep -E "OOM|KVCache"`
Emma L: handing off to Pedro M for overnight stable monitoring and follow-up. I'm going to run postmortem ticket skeleton.
Pedro M: ack. I'll monitor the canary dashboards and coordinate with Marco if we see any re-emergence. If anything regresses I'll escalate to the on-call lead.
Lia Chen: revert PR created: https://git.internal/repo/pull/12345 and CI passed. Preparing hotfix release now. Patch notes: revert prefetch + add guard `max_kv_cache_bytes=1GB` default.
Marco G: starting hotfix rollout to remaining canaries: command: `k8s rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime --selector=canary=true` — watching.
deploy-bot: Canary metric update: 5xx rate on canaries trending down to baseline (5xx in last 1m = 0.02%, pre-incident baseline 0.025%).
Marco G: hotfix rolled to remaining canaries, no new OOMs reported, memory profiles look stable.
Alex R: sending customer messages now to the 3 impacted Dedicated accounts with summary + mitigation + ETA for prod. copying infra/CS per runbook.
Emma L: thanks. I'll create incident-2026-03-KVprefetch ticket for postmortem, RCA owner: Lia, timeline + mitigation tasks.
Pedro M: quick asks for follow-up: please attach sampling traces for the affected time window and the revert PR diff to the ticket. I'll keep monitoring until morning handoff.
Sanjay Patel: leaving a note to add a unit/regression test for cache soft-cap behavior under shard rebalancing.
Emma L: closing this thread for active ops — moving ongoing trace/PM updates to incident ticket. big thanks everyone :heart: 
Pedro M: ack, monitoring.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: canary 5xx normalized, hotfix deployed to canary pool. Postmortem ticket created: incident-2026-03-KVprefetch (assigned).
